I downloaded this app back in August or September of 2025 along with a few other similar apps to see how much I could make from walking. I ended up deleting the other apps since Walk Task seemed to give the most “coins” and show the least number of ads. The app itself is nice (keeps track of steps, nice UI, easy to use, can earn extra coins by completing certain “tiers” of steps walked then watching ads, etc.). However, once it comes time to do the main thing that you downloaded the app for in the first place - cash out - it becomes a scam.

After months of using this app, I finally earned enough coins needed to make a $5 PayPal cash out request. When submitting the request on December 11th, the app informed me it may take up to 3 business days to process the cash out - I understood, and was fine with this. Now, here I am 16 DAYS LATER, and my cash out still says “In Review”. I have reached out to support 3 TIMES with NO RESPONSE (messaged them twice in-app, and once via direct email). I have politely explained my situation, provided my information as well as screenshots - but have yet to hear a peep out of them, let alone have my issue resolved.

TLDR, After months of using the app, finally earned enough coins to cash out $5. I submitted the payout request, waited the 3 business days for processing, now here I am 16 days later with a pending payout still “In Review”. I have reached out to customer support 3 separate times with no response or acknowledgment.

This app appears to be a scam that harvests your data, then ignores you when you’re ready to cash out a few measly dollars.
